original_test_intent: Verify the specified CDU connector leak sensor detects an approved localized connector stimulus, asserts the correct alarm/protective action, and returns to normal after safe cleanup and verified dryness.
original_method: Identify CDU, connector, sensor zone/channel and nearby energized components; isolate and contain; qualified cooling operator uses a vendor-approved connector leak fixture/simulator or metered compatible fluid at the defined location; record sensor/SEL/alarm/action timing; remove/collect fluid with approved method; inspect and verify dryness/connector integrity; confirm deassertion and controlled recovery/final state.
manual_activity: Qualified cooling/electrical operator applies/removes the approved connector stimulus and verifies dry integrity; agent may collect alarm/SEL/power evidence.
required_inputs: CDU/connector physical identity and sensor zone/channel map
Vendor-approved simulator/test fluid, location/amount/dwell and containment
Electrical isolation, cleanup/dryness/inspection, re-energization and recovery
safety_requirements: Isolate dedicated system and use containment/PPE/ESD/qualified operator
Never spray uncontrolled water toward a live CDU connector
Prevent fluid migration into contacts or energized equipment; define hard aborts
Do not re-energize until approved dryness/contact inspection; no retry
agent_execution_scope: Correlate operator stimulus, cleanup and dry markers
Do not spray/wipe hardware, choose shutdown policy, re-energize, clear logs, retry or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve connector/map and safe localized stimulus
Approve cleanup, inspection, dryness and recovery
Review evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No remote command exercises the physical connector sensor; telemetry is supplemental.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Stream the exact leak sensor, SEL, alarms and power state around the qualified operator's localized stimulus and cleanup.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Connector stimulus, warning/protective response, wiping/drying and recovery remain; literal spray is safety-gated.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a connector-specific simulator or metered compatible fluid with barriers, contact protection and verified dry inspection.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces uncontrolled spray/wipe with localized repeatable stimulus and connector-safe recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A generic sensor simulation may omit fluid-path/placement coverage; uncontrolled wetting may test damage rather than detection.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Liquid can wick into connector contacts and cause delayed corrosion or shorts even after the exterior appears dry.

project_override_considerations: If the connector must remain energized for detection, engineering must provide a qualified low-risk fixture and isolation boundary; otherwise use the approved powered-down/simulated method and document coverage.
expected_evidence: Cleanup, contact inspection and independent dryness record
Deassertion, recovery/final state and engineer verdict

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2276 Wistron-BMC-00693-V003: approve exact CDU connector and leak-sensor zone/channel/SEL map; vendor-approved connector simulator or compatible fluid, application point/amount/dwell/containment and physical-coverage requirement; exact warning/severity/protective action including whether one-minute shutdown is mandatory; approve electrical isolation, cleanup/contact inspection, dryness criterion, re-energization, deassertion and final recovery.

review_improvement: Preserves connector leak coverage while preventing uncontrolled water spray into high-risk contacts and requiring latent-damage-aware recovery.
independent_technical_reasoning: Connector testing differs from a leak-line test because fluid can enter conductive contacts and remain trapped after surface wiping. Detection sensitivity depends on exact placement and sensor zone, while exterior dryness does not prove contact integrity. A valid plan therefore needs a localized compatible stimulus or simulator, barriers and isolation, synchronized event/action evidence, contact inspection and independent dryness before re-energization.
